units.source_text: 名人非常沮丧和焦灼，他一听说达成协议，当场抖擞精神，恨不得立即对阵，于是做出了简单的反应。

en.t: The Master was extremely dejected and anxious, but as soon as he heard that an agreement had been reached, he rallied on the spot and, wishing he could face his opponent at once, gave a simple response.

units.source_text: 但是七段对这个反应非常警惕。

en.t: But the seventh-dan player was very wary of this response.

units.source_text: 几天的纠纷，他的脑子已疲惫不堪，他想好好沉下心来，准备重新弈战。

en.t: After several days of dispute, his mind was utterly exhausted, and he wanted to settle himself properly and prepare to resume the match.

units.source_text: 这是两人不同性格的表现。

en.t: This showed the difference between the two men's temperaments.

units.source_text: 另外，七段由于过度费神，前几天起就一直闹肚子。

en.t: In addition, because the seventh-dan player had strained himself too much, he had been suffering from stomach trouble since several days earlier.

units.source_text: 再加上带来旅馆的孩子又患感冒，还发了高烧。

en.t: On top of that, the child he had brought to the inn had caught a cold and developed a high fever.

units.source_text: 溺爱孩子的七段甚是担心。

en.t: The seventh-dan player, who doted on the child, was deeply worried.

units.source_text: 明天无论如何是不能对局了。

en.t: There was no way he could play the game tomorrow.
